title: Answer: failed predictions on self-location and the self-representational blink

statements.text: The theory would be weakened if a minimal sense of self survived opaque self-location, if transparent self-location appeared without one, or if subjects were not blind to self-related stimuli during the self-representational blink. A sound case that a minimal self is present whenever experience is would contradict its claim of selfless consciousness.

sources.quote: Do we know any cases of phenomenally opaque self-location
the empirical prediction is that subjects should be blind to self-related stimuli during the SRB
